Saturate a cotton pad and sweep across the face, neck, and desired body areas. Description: Distribution : Salajit Chitrali, often referred to as Shilajit, is a potent and revered natural substance primarily found in the high-altitude mountain ranges of the Hindu Kush and Himalayan regions, particularly in Chitral (a district in Pakistan). It is a sticky, tar-like resin that exudes from cracks in the rocks, especially during the warmer months when the heat causes it to ooze out from the stones. Characteristics: Color: Salajit Chitrali is typically dark brown or black, and sometimes it can appear glossy or shiny. Texture: It has a thick, tar-like consistency when fresh but can become more solid when cooled. Taste: It is known to have a bitter and earthy taste. Aroma: The resin has a strong, pungent smell, often described as a mixture of earth and minerals. Composition: Salajit Chitrali is rich in minerals, fulvic acid, and humic acid. It contains over 85 essential minerals and trace elements, including iron, calcium, magnesium, zinc, and copper, which contribute to its therapeutic properties. The resin is also believed to contain bioactive compounds such as dibenzo-alpha-pyrones, which are said to have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. Health Benefits: Salajit Chitrali is considered an adaptogen and is used in traditional medicine to improve overall well-being. Some of its claimed benefits include: Boosting energy levels: It is believed to enhance stamina, reduce fatigue, and increase overall vitality. Improving cognitive function: Shilajit is thought to support brain health, improve memory, and aid in concentration. Enhancing sexual health: It has been traditionally used as a natural aphrodisiac and to treat male infertility and low libido. Supporting immune function: It may help strengthen the immune system and combat infections. Anti-aging properties: Its antioxidant-rich composition is believed to help reduce the effects of aging and support healthy skin. Usage: Salajit Chitrali is typically consumed in small amounts, either by dissolving it in warm water, milk, or tea. It is often recommended to take a pea-sized portion daily, and it is sometimes combined with other herbs for enhanced effects. Name: NIKHAR OIL / Coconut cooking  oil and also hair oil
Description:
Coconut oil is used in multiple ways, from cooking to personal care, but people may wonder if it's healthy. While there are countless personal accounts of its benefits, coconut oil lacks robust scientific evidence to support these claims.
A lack of research doesn't necessarily indicate coconut oil isn't beneficial, but it's helpful to look at study findings when making an assessment of its usefulness.
However, coconut oil may be linked to some potential benefits for skin, including reducing inflammation, keeping skin moisturized and helping heal wounds. The medium-chain fatty acids found in coconut oil also possess antimicrobial properties that can help treat acne and protect the skin from harmful bacteria.

Description:
Description




 Indulge in the refreshing and restorative effects of DR RASHEL Vitamin C Facial Cleanser, a dynamic cleansing formula designed to rejuvenate skin’s natural vibrancy and purity. With an enriching boost of potent Vitamin C, it combats environmental damage and neutralizes the effects of sun exposure. This cleanser is fortified with the dual benefits of vitamin C and hyaluronic acid, renowned for their roles in diminishing sun spots, neutralizing discoloration, refining skin texture, and minimizing the look of wrinkles. It provides a gentle yet effective cleansing experience, washing away impurities to unveil a youthful, brightened complexion with a noticeable whitening effect.

 	Antioxidant Power: Enriched with Vitamin C to repair and prevent the effects of environmental damage, such as pollution and UV rays.
 	Age-Defying Benefits: Ingredients aim to reduce the visibility of wrinkles and enhance skin texture.
 	Complexion Correction: Assists in fading sun spots and correcting discoloration to even out skin tone.

 	Hydration Boost: Hyaluronic acid provides necessary hydration, leaving skin supple after cleansing.
 	Suitable for Complexion Refinement: Leaves skin with a more youthful appearance and whitening glow.

Suitable For: All skin types, including those prone to sun damage or those seeking to improve skin texture and reduce signs of aging.

How to Use:

 	Wet Face: Start with dampening your face with warm water to help open up the pores.
 	Apply Cleanser: Dispense a pea-sized amount of the facial cleanser onto your fingertips or onto a cleansing brush.
 	Gentle Massage: Gently massage the cleanser onto your face in circular motions, focusing on areas prone to impurities, like the T-zone, for about 30 seconds to a minute.
 	Rinse Off: Thoroughly rinse with lukewarm water, ensuring all cleanser is removed from your face.
 	Pat Dry: Gently pat your face dry with a clean towel; do not rub, as this can irritate the skin.
 	Follow-Up: Continue with your skincare routine, possibly with a toner, serum, and moisturizer for optimal results.

Extra Note: For those with sensitive skin, a patch test may be advisable to ensure compatibility with the cleanser. Chris's Professional Ginger & Vetiver Shampoo is a premium hair care product infused with the natural benefits of ginger and vetiver. Stimulates Hair Growth: Ginger is known for its invigorating properties that can stimulate hair follicles and encourage growth.
Soothes Scalp: Vetiver provides a calming and soothing effect, which can help reduce scalp irritation.
Improves Hair Strength: Ginger's natural components may contribute to stronger hair, reducing breakage.
Cleanses and Refreshes: The combination of ginger and vetiver effectively cleanses the hair, leaving it refreshed and revitalized.
Adds Shine and Vitality: This shampoo helps restore hair's natural shine and vitality, enhancing its overall appearance.

Description:
Introduction: Ubtan Scrub is a modern skincare product inspired by this ancient beauty ritual. It is a natural exfoliating scrub made from a blend of finely ground herbs, grains, and other natural ingredients, such as turmeric, sandalwood, chickpea flour, and rose water, that work together to gently slough off dead skin cells, unclog pores, and improve skin texture and tone. The Ubtan Scrub can be used on the face or body to brighten and even out the skin tone, reduce the appearance of blemishes, and leave the skin feeling smooth and refreshed. It is typically applied to damp skin and massaged in a circular motion before being rinsed off with warm water. The Ubtan Scrub is suitable for most skin types, but it's important to perform a patch test before using it, especially if you have sensitive or reactive skin.

How To Use: Here are some general steps on how to use Ubtan Scrub:

Take a small amount of Ubtan Scrub and mix it with water or rose water to create a paste. You can also add some milk or yogurt for added hydration and nourishment.

Gently apply the paste to your skin in a circular motion, massaging it in for 1-2 minutes.

Let the scrub sit on your skin for a few minutes, allowing the natural ingredients to work their magic.

Rinse off the scrub with warm water, making sure to remove all of the paste.

Pat your skin dry with a clean towel.

Ubtan Scrub is typically used 1-2 times a week, depending on your skin type and concerns.

Name: Almond Cleansing Milk (100ml) skin looks clean and feels fresh
Description:
Cleansing Milk (100ml) By Moon Touch











Almond Cleansing Milk is a skincare product that incorporates almond oil as a key ingredient to cleanse and nourish the skin. Almond oil is known for its moisturizing and soothing properties, making it a popular choice for skincare products.

When using almond cleansing milk, it's typically applied to the face and neck area and gently massaged in circular motions. The product helps to remove impurities, dirt, and makeup from the skin while leaving it hydrated and soft.

The benefits of using almond cleansing milk may include:

 	Gentle Cleansing: Almond cleansing milk effectively removes dirt, excess oil, and makeup without stripping the skin of its natural moisture.
 	Nourishment: Almond oil is rich in essential fatty acids, antioxidants, and vitamins, such as vitamin E, which can help nourish and protect the skin.
 	Hydration: The moisturizing properties of almond oil can help hydrate and soften the skin, leaving it feeling supple and smooth.
 	Soothing and Calming: Almond oil has soothing properties that can help calm irritated or sensitive skin, making it suitable for various skin types, including dry and sensitive skin.
 	Anti-Aging Effects: The antioxidants present in almond oil can help protect the skin from environmental damage and reduce the signs of aging, such as fine lines and wrinkles.

When choosing an almond cleansing milk, it's important to consider your skin type and any specific concerns you may have. It's also advisable to check the product's ingredients list and perform a patch test if you have known allergies or sensitivities.

Note: While almond cleansing milk can be beneficial for many individuals, if you have a nut allergy, it's essential to avoid using products containing almond oil and consult with a healthcare professional for suitable alternatives.
